```{=html}
<p>
\[
\begin{aligned}

\text{WOA}_i &= \begin{cases} 
    \begin{array}{l}
    0 &\text{ with } p = \eta_{D_i} \\
    0.5 &\text{ with } p = \eta_{M_i} \\
    1 &\text{ with } p = \eta_{A_i} \\
    c &\text{ with } p = 1 - \eta_{A_i} - \eta_{D_i} - \eta_{M_i}
    \end{array} 
\end{cases} && \note{probabilities for each outcome} \\

\text{logit}(\eta_{D_i}) &= \alpha_{\eta_D} + \alpha_{\eta_{D_{j[i]}}} + \alpha_{\eta_{D_{k[i]}}} + \alpha_{\eta_{D_{s[i]}}} \\
\text{logit}(\eta_{M_i}) &= \alpha_{\eta_M} + \alpha_{\eta_{M_{j[i]}}} + \alpha_{\eta_{M_{k[i]}}} + \alpha_{\eta_{M_{s[i]}}} && \note{logit models with random effects} \\
\text{logit}(\eta_{A_i}) &= \alpha_{\eta_A} + \alpha_{\eta_{A_{j[i]}}} + \alpha_{\eta_{A_{k[i]}}} + \alpha_{\eta_{A_{s[i]}}} \\

[\alpha_{\eta_{D_{j[i]}}}, \alpha_{\eta_{D_{k[i]}}}, \alpha_{\eta_{D_{s[i]}}}] 
&\sim Normal(0, \ 
[\sigma_{\eta_{D_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{D_{k[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{D_{s[i]}}}]) \\

[\alpha_{\eta_{M_{j[i]}}}, \alpha_{\eta_{M_{k[i]}}}, \alpha_{\eta_{M_{s[i]}}}] 
&\sim Normal(0, \ 
[\sigma_{\eta_{M_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{M_{k[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{M_{s[i]}}}]) && \note{random effect distributions for logit} \\

[\alpha_{\eta_{A_{j[i]}}}, \alpha_{\eta_{A_{k[i]}}}, \alpha_{\eta_{A_{s[i]}}}] 
&\sim Normal(0, \ 
[\sigma_{\eta_{A_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{A_{k[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{A_{s[i]}}}]) \\


c &\sim Beta(\mu_{C_i} \phi_{C_i}, (1 - \mu_{C_i}) \phi_{C_i}) && \note{continuous component for compromise}  \\

\mu_{C_i} &= \alpha_{\mu_C} + \alpha_{\mu_{C_{j[i]}}} + \alpha_{\mu_{C_{k[i]}}} + \alpha_{\mu_{C_{s[i]}}} && \note{linear model for each Beta parameter} \\

\phi_{C_i} &= \alpha_{\phi_C} + \alpha_{\phi_{C_{j[i]}}} + \alpha_{\phi_{C_{k[i]}}} + \alpha_{\phi_{C_{s[i]}}} \\

[\alpha_{\mu_{C_{j[i]}}}, \alpha_{\mu_{C_{k[i]}}}, \alpha_{\mu_{C_{s[i]}}}] 
&\sim Normal(0, \
[\sigma_{\mu_{C_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\mu_{C_{k[i]}}}, \sigma_{\mu_{C_{s[i]}}}]) && \note{random effect distributions for Beta} \\ 

[\alpha_{\phi_{C_{j[i]}}}, \alpha_{\phi_{C_{k[i]}}}, \alpha_{\phi_{C_{s[i]}}}] 
&\sim Normal(0, 
[\sigma_{\phi_{C_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\phi_{C_{k[i]}}}, \sigma_{\phi_{C_{s[i]}}}]) \\ \\

\alpha_{\eta_D}, \alpha_{\eta_M}, \alpha_{\eta_A} &\sim Normal(0, 5) && \note{priors on population means} \\

[\sigma_{\eta_{D_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{D_{k[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{D_{s[i]}}}] &\sim Student\text{-}t(3, 0, 2.5) \\
[\sigma_{\eta_{M_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{M_{k[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{M_{s[i]}}}] &\sim Student\text{-}t(3, 0, 2.5) && \note{priors on variances of cluster effects}\\
[\sigma_{\eta_{A_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{A_{k[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{A_{s[i]}}}] &\sim Student\text{-}t(3, 0, 2.5) \\

\alpha_{\mu_C}, \alpha_{\phi_C} &\sim Normal(0, 5) && \note{priors on population means} \\

[\sigma_{\mu_{C_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\mu_{C_{k[i]}}}, \sigma_{\mu_{C_{s[i]}}}] &\sim Student\text{-}t(3, 0, 2.5) && \note{priors on variances of cluster effects} \\
[\sigma_{\phi_{C_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\phi_{C_{k[i]}}}, \sigma_{\phi_{C_{s[i]}}}] &\sim Student\text{-}t(3, 0, 2.5) \\

\end{aligned}
\]
</p>
```
